The**Ministry of Citizen Protection**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Προστασίας του Πολίτη,[romanized](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romanization_of_Greek):*Ypourgeío Prostasías tou Polítī*) is the[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))responsible for[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece)'s[public security](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_security)services.

The ministry existed until 2007 as the**Ministry of Public Order**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Δημόσιας Τάξης,[romanized](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romanization_of_Greek):*Ypourgeío Dīmósias Táxīs*). On 19 September 2007, it was merged with the Ministry of the Interior, Public Administration and Decentralization and reduced to a General Secretariat within the[Ministry of the Interior](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_the_Interior_(Greece)).
